vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: cloudkit-code-review
Version: 1.2.0

The cloudkit-code-review skill bundle is a legitimate tool designed to assist an AI agent in reviewing iOS/macOS code for CloudKit implementation best practices. The bundle consists of a structured SKILL.md and several reference documents (e.g., records.md, sharing.md) that provide accurate technical guidance on handling containers, records, and subscriptions. There is no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection; the instructions are strictly focused on identifying common developer errors and anti-patterns.

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent: it only contains review instructions and CloudKit reference docs and asks for no credentials or installs. Before installing, consider provenance — the skill's source/homepage is unknown, so verify you trust the publisher if you plan to let an agent run it autonomously. Also bear in mind reference docs may become outdated with API changes; validate any remediation suggestions against current CloudKit docs and test suggestions in a safe environment before applying to production code.
